title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Dangerous-Goods Uplift Percentage
content:
Each Demurrage and Detention Free Time product states an uplift, in whole percent, by which demurrage day rates are raised for a container moving on a dangerous-goods booking. The figure belongs to the product the record carries.

| Product | Uplift on demurrage day rates |
|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 50 percent |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 50 percent |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 50 percent |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 50 percent |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 50 percent |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 25 percent |

## Quick points

- The percentage is a property of demurrage day rates; it is stated per product and not per rate class.
- The contract product carries the lower figure; every tariff, extension and combined product carries the higher one.

Hypothetical illustration: a demurrage day rate of 100.00 raised by 50 percent of itself becomes 150.00, and raised by 25 percent of itself becomes 125.00.
